changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionLog') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionLog]( Id bigint identity not null, [ExecutionId] int not null, Payload nvarchar(max) not null, SubTask char(1) null, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionLog] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( Id asc ) ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionLog_ExecutionId') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionLog_ExecutionId] ON [api].[ExecutionLog] ( [ExecutionId] DESC ) END
